req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of updating an existing player via the PUT /players/{playerId} endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The tests are designed to catch common mutation operators by asserting exact values, testing both sides of comparisons, and covering boundary conditions.

tests.name: Update existing player successfully
preconditions: Player with squad number 5 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/5 with valid player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Vivaan",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Nair",
    "dateOfBirth": "1905-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 5,
    "position": "Central Midfield",
    "abbrPosition": "AM",
    "team": "Independiente",
    "league": "Liga Profesional",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/5", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: Update player with mismatched squad number
preconditions: Player with squad number 5 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/5 with player data having squad number 6.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Vivaan",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Nair",
    "dateOfBirth": "1905-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 6,
    "position": "Central Midfield",
    "abbrPosition": "AM",
    "team": "Independiente",
    "league": "Liga Profesional",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/5", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 400
